# apierr

```go
import "github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/internal/apierr"
```

Package apierr defines the Secrets Manager \(AWS JSON 1.1\) error types and their HTTP status.

Every handler returns \*Error \(or an error wrapping one\); anything else is reported to the client as InternalServiceError and logged.

<a name="Error"></a>
## type [Error](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/apierr/apierr.go#L14-L18>)

Error is an AWS\-style API error. Code is the bare exception name \(the "\_\_type"\).

```go
type Error struct {
    Code    string
    Message string
    Status  int
}
```

<a name="Validation"></a>
### func [Validation](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/apierr/apierr.go#L114>)

```go
func Validation(format string, a ...any) *Error
```

Validation is the protocol\-level constraint error \(length, pattern, range, required\) that AWS returns before reaching the service, e.g. "1 validation error detected: Value null at 'secretId' failed to satisfy constraint: Member must not be null".

<a name="ValidationErrors"></a>

```go
func ValidationErrors(violations []string) *Error
```

ValidationErrors joins constraint violations the way AWS formats them: "2 validation errors detected: \<a\>; \<b\>".
